name: week
title: Sample storage week
subtitle: Nonclinical research material. Read-only working record.

sections.title: Work requiring attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by due nulls first,code

sections.title: Returns
sections.sql: select * from returns_due order by return_due

sections.title: Reserved positions
sections.sql: select box,freezer,capacity,reserved,available from storage_capacity order by box

sections.title: Recorded conditions
sections.sql: select code,min_c,max_c,temperature_c,observed_at,finding from storage_conditions order by code
sections.note: Manual observations. This is not an alarm or equipment controller.

sections.title: Physical count list
sections.sql: select code,name,box,position,quantity,unit,status,review_due from sample_inventory order by box,position,code
